landing.heroSubtitle: Sessio automates training confirmations, reminders, and waitlist backfill for sports coaches. Your athletes confirm in one tap. You just show up.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to run group trainings without the daily back-and-forth.
landing.feature1Desc: Athletes get a heads-up before each training and confirm with one tap. No follow-up, no guessing who shows up.
landing.feature2Desc: Someone cancels? The next athlete on the waitlist gets the spot automatically — zero effort from you.
landing.feature3Desc: See who's confirmed, who's out, and how full each training is — from one screen, before you even leave home.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Your athletes don't need to download anything first.
landing.step1Desc: Set up recurring trainings with sport, time, location and capacity. Takes two minutes.
landing.step2Desc: Share a join code. Your existing athletes sign up in seconds — they don't need an account first.
landing.step3Desc: Confirmations, reminders and waitlist backfill run automatically. Your job is just to coach.
landing.ctaSubtitle: No credit card. No migration pain. Bring your existing athletes in minutes.
